note: GFP recreation area on the north shore of Lewis and Clark Lake just above Gavins Point Dam, 5 miles west of Yankton. Three campgrounds strung about 4 km along the shore (Gavins Point, Midway, Yankton), mostly in shade trees; a paved shore trail and riprap separate even the front-row sites from the water. Gavins Point Horse Camp (8 sites with corrals) is its own loop at the west end. The marina, motel and restaurant are run by a private resort. --Claude
